Source: git history of this repo only (all branches). No code is quoted, because the committee can't see it. Nothing here comes from CI, issue trackers, review tools or usage data. Figures are lines added per commit as reported by `git log --numstat`.

| Area | What | Date (author) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Feature | JSON export for tables (new module) | 12 Jan | +60 lines |

| Tests | JSON export tests | 14 Mar | +90 lines (see caveat D) |
| Docs | Pagination explainer | 15 Apr | +40 lines |
| Feature | CLI flag for JSON export | 28 Jun | +45 lines (see caveat B) |
